meta.purpose: High-accuracy OCR and document-understanding pipeline for marked physical exercises, worksheets and exam papers.

design_principle: OCR is never treated as a single pass or as ground truth. Printed text, handwriting, teacher marks, layout and scores are extracted separately, reconciled, confidence-scored and reviewable.

provider_strategy.primary: document-optimized OCR service with printed+handwritten extraction, layout polygons, word confidence and multilingual support
provider_strategy.fallback_provider: Google Document AI OCR or a second independent OCR engine for low-confidence regions
provider_strategy.reason: Use a document-native OCR engine first; invoke fallback only on uncertain regions to improve accuracy while controlling cost.

pipeline.name: mark_symbol_detection
pipeline.note: Do not rely on OCR alone for graphical marks; use visual classification/object detection.

pipeline.name: color_role_separation
pipeline.goal: Separate likely teacher markings from student writing when pen colours differ
pipeline.rule: Colour is supporting evidence, never sole evidence.

pipeline.name: semantic_reconstruction
actions: restore Malay punctuation where safely inferable
separate teacher correction from student original answer

pipeline.name: selective_second_pass
pipeline.trigger: field confidence below threshold or OCR engines disagree

pipeline.name: human_review_gate
pipeline.rule: Low-confidence or diagnosis-critical fields must be shown for teacher confirmation before they alter the student's confirmed weakness profile.

high.action: auto-accept for ordinary text if internally consistent

medium.action: accept provisionally; highlight when diagnosis depends on it

low.action: rerun/fallback; if unresolved require human confirmation

confidence_policy.diagnosis_critical: Correct/wrong status, question number, student answer, score and skill mapping require stricter confirmation than decorative or header text.

malay_specific_rules: Do not silently normalize a student spelling error into the correct Malay word; preserve raw OCR and normalized candidate separately.
Keep di- prefix versus di preposition distinctions observable because they may be the actual grammar error.
Preserve hyphens in kata ganda and punctuation because they may be diagnostically relevant.
Store uncertain characters as alternatives rather than forcing a word when confidence is low.
Do not use a language model to 'fix' the student's answer before diagnostic analysis.
failure_modes_to_test: teacher writes correct answer above wrong answer
teacher score 1/2 or 2/3 misread as dates
privacy_note: Original student document images and extracted data should be access-controlled and retained only according to the product's explicit storage policy.
